claims.sentence: Faculty courses are not mandatory for students and are not included in the annual volume of the educational program
Elective disciplines (modules) are mandatory for students in bachelor’s, master’s, and graduate programs
For graduate students in programs developed in accordance with FGT, electives are mandatory only if the University has included them in the graduate program
In study plans, elective disciplines (modules) are presented alternatively
Each block contains at least two disciplines (modules)
Students may select no more than one discipline from a block
If a discipline (module) is presented in two or more blocks, a student may choose to study it no more than once
